question: After completing a 24-month course of teriparatide, it is essential to immediately start an anti-resorptive agent (e.g., a bisphosphonate or denosumab) to preserve the bone density gained.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Sequential anti-resorptive therapy after teriparatide is a critical treatment rule — skipping it results in rapid loss of the bone density gains achieved.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct! Without sequential anti-resorptive therapy, the bone mass gained with teriparatide is rapidly lost within 12–24 months after stopping the anabolic agent.
